answer: Randomized proof-of-burn gating. A new identity is worthless until it burns a fee whose size is drawn from a beacon opening after registration. Draws are independent and burns single-use, one burn never funds a second identity, so each sybil puppet pays its full draw with no bulk discount, while an honest participant pays once and earns forever; attacker cost scales linearly with fake count. Like a dune field where each grain costs wind to move, flooding a meadow of honest nodes with sparrow-weight replicas costs more than they harvest.
